description: Ministry of Labour, Trade Union Relations - The Award made to the Industrial Dispute between Sri Lanka Nidahas Sewaka Sangamaya with Independent Workers Trade Union and Milco (Pvt.) Ltd. (E only)
categorisation: This gazette content primarily concerns the publication of an arbitration award related to an industrial dispute under the Industrial Disputes Act. It involves legal proceedings, statutory arbitration, and the enforcement of labor regulations, making it a clear example of Legal/Regulatory matters (Type 5). The content does not involve government structure/personnel changes (Types 1-3) or fit any other specialized categories like Land, Commercial, Elections, etc.
